name: 23 NYCRR Part 504 — Transaction Monitoring and Filtering Programs

articles.title: Regulated Institutions
articles.requirement: Applies to: banks, trust companies, private bankers, savings banks + savings + loan associations chartered under NY Banking Law; branches + agencies of foreign banks licensed by NY; check cashers + money transmitters licensed under NY Banking Law. Other NYDFS-regulated institutions (insurers + virtual currency businesses) operate under Part 500 + sanctions obligations rather than Part 504.

articles.title: Transaction Monitoring Program
articles.requirement: Risk-based program reasonably designed to monitor transactions after their execution for potential BSA/AML violations + suspicious-activity reporting. Required elements include: based on the institution's Risk Assessment; documented; periodically reviewed + updated; threshold-setting + parameter validation; ongoing tuning + governance; investigation + decision-making protocols; staff training; technology validation if technology-driven; documentation of decisions.

articles.title: Watchlist Filtering Program
articles.requirement: Risk-based program reasonably designed to interdict transactions prohibited by OFAC + other applicable sanctions. Required elements include: based on Risk Assessment; documented; technology approved by qualified personnel; matching logic; ongoing tuning + governance; investigation + decision-making; staff training; documentation of decisions.

articles.title: Annual Certification — Senior Officer compliance finding
articles.requirement: Annually by 15 April: written certification by the Board of Directors or a Senior Officer that the institution's Transaction Monitoring + Filtering Program complies with Part 504. Form prescribed by Appendix A. Records supporting the certification retained for 5 years. Aligns with the Part 500 §500.17(b) cybersecurity certification cycle.

articles.title: Enforcement + penalties
articles.requirement: Civil monetary penalties under the Banking Law + Financial Services Law (per Financial Services Law §408). Part 504 enforcement notable for the precedent set in the 2017 DPB Mashreqbank consent order + subsequent actions tying transaction-monitoring + filtering deficiencies to substantial fines.

articles.title: Independent testing + validation
articles.requirement: Programs subject to independent testing by qualified internal or external party + validation of underlying assumptions, methodologies + design. Frequency proportionate to risk. Findings documented + remediation tracked.
